name: cellsweep
description: CellSweep — non-custodial cell hygiene and coin control for Nervos CKB

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w @cell-hygiene/core && npm run typecheck -w @cell-hygiene/guard
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @cell-hygiene/core && npm run build -w @cell-hygiene/guard
